headline: Xbox chief executive Asha Sharma announced a new group called Xbox Labs to explore AI after fans began fusing popular games together with AI.
score_reason: Light gaming story; the new unit's work is described as vague.
importance_line: Gamers and developers may get tools from Xbox's AI experiments, though Radio Times says the plan is vague and arrives after Xbox studio layoffs.
summary: Radio Times reports that Xbox chief executive Asha Sharma has announced Xbox Labs, a small group of game makers, engineers and scientists meant to turn emerging ideas into things players and developers can use, after AI mash-ups that fuse the code of different games, such as Minecraft with Elden Ring, spread online. Radio Times notes that what the group will actually do is vague and that it is being created after mass layoffs at Xbox studios.
notes: Read in full. Sharma's statement names 'Scott' without a surname; not guessed.
